entities.name: Social Contract Theory
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The philosophical concept that legitimate political authority rests on an agreement among individuals to form a society and government. Developed by Hobbes, Locke, and Rousseau, social contract theory provided the intellectual foundation for democratic revolutions and modern constitutional governance.
